items.title: Vistra Shares Rise 5% as Q3 Profit Surges Despite Revenue Miss, Raises 2026 Outlook
items.summary: Vistra Corp. (NYSE:VST) shares gained approximately 5% in premarket trading after the power generation company reported strong third-quarter 2026 profit growth and raised its full-year earnings guidance, despite revenue falling short of Wall Street expectations.

items.title: Vistra stock jumps despite revenue miss
